tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `gpt-6.1-sol`: Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.

        Spawns an agent to work on the specified task. If your current task is `/root/task1` and you spawn_agent with task_name "task_3" the agent will have canonical task name `/root/task1/task_3`.
You are then able to refer to this agent as `task_3` or `/root/task1/task_3` interchangeably. However an agent `/root/task2/task_3` would only be able to communicate with this agent via its canonical name `/root/task1/task_3`.
The spawned agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

It will be able to send you and other running agents messages, and its final answer will be provided to you when it finishes.
The new agent's canonical task name will be provided to it along with the message.

Note that passing `fork_turns="none"` will not pass any surrounding context to the spawned subagent, which may cause the agent to lack the context it needs to complete its task, whereas `fork_turns="all"` will provide the subagent with all surrounding context.

tools.description:
Control native apps or browsers on the user’s computer by reading or operating UI. Prefer purpose-built skills, connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

On the first invocation of `cua_repl`, or after resetting it, execute exactly one of the API calls shown below, optionally assigning its result to a variable. Do not add other API calls, waits, or snapshots to that invocation.
The tool result will include documentation and, when creating or selecting a tab or selecting an app, its initial UI state. Selecting a browser does not open a tab. Read that result before continuing.
Use only APIs described in the tool instructions or returned documentation.

When you need an inventory of available apps, browsers, and tabs, get a snapshot of all enabled surfaces. Otherwise, use the relevant entry point below:

```javascript
await cua.getState();
```

Use the first matching browser control option from the user's request:

For a tab @-mention (`mention=tab-v1`):
Pass the complete `plugin://...` URL to get the referenced tab.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ mention: tabMentionUrl });
```

For an existing tab identified by URL in browser context (including the current IAB tab):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ url }, { browser: browserId });
```

Known tab ID (`tabId` or `providerTabId`) and browser (name or browser @-mention):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: browserId });
```

To open a URL in the in-app browser (`@Browser`):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab("iab", url, { visible: boolean });
```

To open a URL in another named browser: pass its name directly; do not call `getBrowser` first.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab(browserName, url, browserOptions);
```

Known URL, only when the user has not specified a browser by name or @-mention:

```javascript
let browser = await cua.getBrowser({ url });
```

Browser IDs and options:

- `"mcpapps"`: use `cua.getBrowser({ id: "mcpapps" })` for existing full-screen MCP Apps in the task’s side panel.
- `"iab"` (in-app browser): in `createBrowserTab`, use `visible: true` to show the browser; `false` to keep it hidden.
- `"dot"` (Dot): use only when present in browser inventory. It accesses tabs on Dot's active main thread. `cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: "dot" })` selects an existing tab. `cua.createBrowserTab("dot", url, { visible: boolean })` creates one with the same visibility options as `"iab"`.
- `"chrome"` (@Chrome), `"edge"` (@Edge): pass a short, emoji-prefixed `sessionName` (e.g. `"🔎 Task"`) to `createBrowserTab` when starting a task.

On Windows, choose the requested window by app and title from the inventory. Pass the selected window's ID as returned.

```javascript
let app = await cua.getApp({ windowId: selected.id });
```

To add other content to the tool result, use `nodeRepl.write(value)` for text or other values and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(image)` for images. The APIs listed above already display their documentation or UI state; do not wrap their results in `write` or `emitImage`.

If your context begins with a summary of an existing computer use task, call `await cua.rewriteDocumentation()` before continuing the computer use task to ensure you have a complete view of the necessary documentation.

Several `cua_repl.js` calls may work toward the same goal. As soon as you observe the final outcome of the CUA part of the task, make your next tool call `cua_repl.js` with only `completion_summary`, exactly once. Do this before using another tool for the next part of the user’s request or sending your reply, even if the overall request continues. If you hand control to the user, wait to summarize until the handoff has ended and you’ve observed the final outcome of the CUA part of the task. This tool is part of plugin `unified-computer-use`.

{"i":0,"status":"fulfilled","value":{"chunk_id":"7d1c43","wall_time_seconds":0.8000327,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":6954,"output":"# FORGE v4 — Persistent Router Agent System

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose autonomous Agent desktop application.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-15

Phase 2 backend acceptance is in progress. The frozen V24 suite recorded
**1,734 passed tests**, with one existing warning in 465.71 seconds; Ruff,
formatting, dependency, whitespace and original-evidence checks passed. All
three strict live runs failed during planning, before any Worker execution.
All 15 model attempts settled (87,044 tokens). The V23 source-prefetch protocol
is implemented, but these failed runs do not establish actual-model completion.
V25 adds explicit model-selected capacity profiles and bounded complete
diagnostics to address repeated infeasible plans within the original caps.
See [ADR-011](docs/adr/ADR-011-approved-declared-source-prefetch.md).
V25 frozen tests and strict live acceptance remain pending.

See the [current status](docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md), [Phase 2 report](docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md),
[experiments](docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md) and [V22 historical boundary](docs/audit/phase2/acceptance-independent-v22-boundary.md).
Historical failures and original evidence remain preserved. The real algorithm
microstudy scored 25/90 task successes; it does not establish general policy gains.
Frontend work is being handled separately; packaging is outside this sprint.

Phase 1 Milestones 1–6 provide the persistence, governance, Registry, DAG, native Workers, tool/evidence and context/budget foundation. Historical M6 verification passed 372 tests; one bounded live continuation succeeded after five retained diagnostic failures. The [M7 backend hardening round](docs/PHASE1_MILESTONE7_BACKEND_HARDENING.md) passed 488 local tests. Desktop Alpha, final native integration and packaging are deferred; these historical backend results do not establish a desktop release.

See [current status](docs/STATUS.md), the [Phase 0 audit report](docs/PHASE0_AUDIT.md), and the report's dependency-ordered development plan. The release references `codex/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, but that file is missing from the supplied archive.

**The user has one persistent conversation.** A persistent Router Agent owns that conversation and coordinates multiple long-running Quests and hidden Worker Sessions. Workers have isolated execution contexts, but they are never presented as separate user conversations.

## Product invariants

1. One persistent user-facing conversation per workspace.
2. One persistent Router identity and resumable state per workspace.
3. Multiple durable Quests can run behind that conversation.
4. Worker Sessions are private execution contexts, not user-facing chats.
5. Worker events are selectively relayed into the single conversation timeline.
6. Model Provider, Model Profile, Role Template, Agent Instance, Quest and Session are separate domain entities.
7. Model Registry uses provider metadata, FORGE benchmark results, online performance and explicit user overrides.
8. Team composition combines reusable role templates with bounded dynamic role synthesis.
9. FORGE owns its Agent Loop, Router, Worker Runtime, Tool Engine, Memory, Governance and Evidence.
10. Codex, DSH and Claude Code are architectural references only, never execution backends.

## What this release contains

- Typed Python domain layer and repository interfaces.
- SQLite persistence with schema versioning and transaction boundaries.
- Persistent `main` conversation and Router identity.
- Quest lifecycle state machine and hidden Worker Session records.
- Durable event log with sequence cursor.
- Model Registry and explainable capability-fit team composition baseline.
- Provider gateway and explicit unconfigured provider; Mock protocol tests are labelled.
- FastAPI API with input validation and consistent error handling.
- React single-conversation UI with background Quest panel.
- Automated tests for persistence, lifecycle, router classification and team composition.
- Architecture, threat model, ADRs, detailed roadmap and Codex execution prompts.

## Important maturity statement

This is an engineering foundation with bounded context recovery, sourced lexical and model semantic recall, and evidence-gated execution. The Router uses a configured Provider or explicitly fails. Mock tests, synthetic experiments and real-provider observations are identified separately. The current independent reviewer uses the approved Worker's model in a fresh context. Bounded feedback-driven remaining-DAG proposals are implemented; their general quality, arbitrary-scale continuity and complex-task correctness remain subject to recorded acceptance. Plan/team/replacement approval stays authenticated and Review mode remains enabled. A proposal record alone never proves execution.

## Backend setup

The model-driven Router requires explicit provider configuration. Set the process environment
variables `FORGE_PROVIDER_ID`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_KIND` (for example `openai_compatible`),
`FORGE_PROVIDER_BASE_URL`, `FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF` (for example
`FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_EXAMPLE`), `FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID`, and
`FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` (an operator-supplied maximum context window). Put the actual
credential only in the process environment variable named by the credential reference. Set
`FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_TOOLS=true` and `FORGE_PROVIDER_SUPPORTS_JSON_SCHEMA=true` only when
the provider supports them. Without configuration the Core starts but Router message calls fail
explicitly; no keyword or mock provider is selected automatically. The optional `request_id`
in a message request allows safe retry: reuse it only for the same input.
For live calls, register an enabled model with the same provider and model ID and explicitly set
both `tool_calling_support` and `structured_output_support` to supported. Unknown capabilities
are rejected. Values submitted through the model API are recorded as user overrides.

Provider timing, Worker ownership and review/output limits use the process environment:

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Per-attempt timeout in seconds; finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `30`. A timeout does not prove the upstream operation stopped. |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_MAX_RETRIES` | Additional Gateway retries, integer `0`–`3`; defaults to `1`. Each HTTP attempt requires its own budget admission. |
| `FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS` | Worker ownership lease, finite and greater than `0`, at most `600`; defaults to `60`. Valid current owners renew between steps, capped by the task deadline. The local call wait is bounded by the current lease; an upstream operation may remain unresolved after that wait ends. |
| `FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS` | Maximum review rounds; integer `1`–`4`, defaults to `2`. The live acceptance harness explicitly selects `3`, matching its scenario cap. This does not reset budgets or change historical runs. |
| `FORGE_PROVIDER_REASONING_EFFORT` | Optional explicit OpenAI-compatible/DeepSeek request setting: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`. Unset sends no setting. Configure only for a model that advertises support; Anthropic configuration rejects it. |
| `FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE` | Router response-token ceiling and reserved output allowance; integer `1`–`8192`, defaults to `2048`. `FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` must be greater than this value. A registered model's known output limit must also support it. |
| `FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT` | Operator-supplied Router context ceiling, required when setting a Router model. Core startup requires an integer greater than `2048` and greater than the configured output reserve. |

The Phase 2 live acceptance harness uses a 120-second timeout, a 150-second Worker lease and zero additional
Gateway retries, with a Router output reserve of `4096` and `FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS=3`
within the scenario's three-round cap. Router/Planner schema repair remains a separately bounded stage;
neither setting authorizes replay of an unresolved external action.

The current WorkBuddy acceptance harness explicitly requests `reasoning_effort=none`,
which the local proxy implementation advertises for the requested model. This is
an operator setting, not independent proof of the upstream model's internal behavior.
Earlier diagnostic runs used the proxy default and retain their separate results.

The Router reads a bounded snapshot and calls the provider outside the database write
transaction. A successful decision and its messages commit together; provider errors, invalid
decisions, or budget failures leave no messages or Quest changes for that turn. The caller can
retry with the same request ID. The context budget uses a conservative UTF-8 byte estimate,
reserves output and request overhead, and also respects a known registry context window. Tool
access is limited to read-only Core queries. Worker execution separately requires approved plan/team contracts and governed tool permissions.

Python 3.11+ recommended.

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
# Windows PowerShell:
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# macOS/Linux:
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-lock.txt
python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e .
pytest
python -m forge_api
```

The lock file is verified on Windows with Python 3.13; other platforms and Python versions have not been verified. The editable installation requires build tooling already available. API documentation endpoints are disabled.

### Core authentication and development bootstrap

Core requires a fresh cryptographically random 32-byte process secret; `.env` is explicitly rejected. For manual browser development, supply it as 64 hex characters in `FORGE_CORE_SECRET` using a protected input method and enter the same secret into the UI's password field. Never place it in command history, source files, URLs, logs, or persistent browser storage. In the native desktop integration, the parent supplies the secret through a private pipe and the UI receives the derived session bearer in memory. Restarting Core invalidates old bearer tokens. Native integration is still undergoing final verification.

The unauthenticated public loopback `/health` returns only liveness and a random per-process session challenge; an authenticated request also receives Router identity and background status. A trusted client computes the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the UTF-8 challenge using the decoded 32-byte secret, and sends `Authorization: Bearer <digest>` on API requests. Requests without an Origin are allowed only with authentication and a loopback peer and Host; browser requests must also use an explicitly allowed Origin. These boundaries protect against unauthorized webpages and other untrusted clients; they do not protect secrets from an attacker who can read the same OS user's process memory. Keep the development server and any allowed origin trusted.

The authenticated user API supports `POST /api/approvals`, `GET /api/approvals?quest_id=...`, `GET /api/approvals/{id}`, and POSTs to `/{id}/decision` or `/{id}/revoke`. Workspace grants use `GET`/`POST /api/quests/{id}/grants` and `POST /api/quests/{id}/grants/revoke`. Decisions and grants record the authenticated local user, not a caller-supplied actor. The bearer represents that user; it must never be exposed to a model or registered as an Agent tool. These routes do not execute actions or accept trusted evidence. The M7 desktop approval and scope controls are under integration testing.

### Workspace and Settings

`python -m forge_api` is the shared Core launcher. From the repository root on Windows, `./scripts/run-backend.ps1` sets up the virtual environment and uses that launcher without shell activation. Pass `-WorkspaceRoot 'D:\YourWorkspace'` to the script, or `python -m forge_api --workspace-root 'D:\YourWorkspace'` directly. Workspace roots must be absolute paths.

The default Workspace is independent of the checkout, installation and shell directory:

| OS | Default Workspace root |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `%LOCALAPPDATA%/FORGE/workspaces/default` |
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/FORGE/workspaces/default` |
| Linux | `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/forge/workspaces/default` |

The database defaults to `<WorkspaceRoot>/data/forge.sqlite3`. Settings are loaded as follows:

1. Choose the root using `--workspace-root`, then the process variable `FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT`, then the OS default (in that order). A root in `.env` is rejected because the root determines which file to read.
2. Load `<WorkspaceRoot>/.env` if present. `FORGE_ENV_FILE` in the process environment can select another file; relative file names resolve from the root. An explicitly selected missing file is an error. The shell directory's `.env` is ignored. Copy `backend/.env.example` to the selected Workspace root.
3. Process variables override file values. Supported settings are `FORGE_WORKSPACE_ID`, `FORGE_DB_PATH`, `FORGE_HOST` and `FORGE_PORT`; empty values and invalid ports fail startup. `.env` does not expand variables or modify the process environment.
4. Resolve relative database paths from the root and normalize them to absolute paths. The default Workspace ID is a hash of the normalized root; an explicit stable ID supports moving a Workspace. A database already bound to another ID is rejected.

The CLI and desktop Core bootstrap use the same Workspace settings and a new process secret. Direct `uvicorn forge_api.main:app` requires the same secret and loopback binding; prefer the shared launcher.

After a workspace restore, a restore fence blocks writes until an offline review succeeds. Close the desktop and Core, inspect the restored workspace and rollback directory, then use the packaged Python executable with the exact manifest hash and rollback directory shown by the application (replace every placeholder):

```powershell
& 'C:\path\to\packaged\python.exe' -I -m forge_api.maintenance review-restore --workspace-root 'C:\path\to\workspace' --manifest-sha256 '<64-lowercase-hex>' --rollback-directory '.forge-previous-<32-hex>' --reason '<10+ character review reason>'
```

The review validates the source hash, rollback directory name, reason, historical receipts and budget state; unresolved effects or reservations cause it to fail closed. Acknowledging an unknown native operation is a separate action and does not clear the restore fence or establish that the operation succeeded.

Legacy databases are **not discovered or moved automatically**. If an earlier version used `backend/data/forge.sqlite3` or another CWD-relative location, stop its Core process, back up the database with SQLite's backup API (or copy the database and WAL files together while stopped), and set `FORGE_DB_PATH` to its absolute path. The first successful open migrates it in place to the current schema without changing the Router ID or existing records. Migration failure rolls back the entire pending chain; unknown future versions and ambiguous version metadata are rejected. Downgrades are unsupported.

Events and pending Outbox rows commit in the same transaction as their associated business changes. Durable per-consumer delivery uses leases, fencing, bounded retries, Inbox deduplication and dead-letter/replay records. Historical events migrate as pending. External tool effects require their own durable intents and receipts; event delivery alone does not make external effects exactly once.

### Approved Worker execution

`python_test` runs bounded pure Python function tests against a governed workspace
file using an isolated subprocess and an AST interpreter. Its approved parameters
are `path`, `function` and `suite.cases` (1–32 input/expected cases). It supports
bounded loops, helpers and recursion; imports, attributes, external calls, file or
network access, and arbitrary shell/pytest execution are unavailable. A failed
case records the actual and expected values in a failed immutable receipt. An
approved Worker can use `file_revise` on its own artifact, rerun the tests and
submit the new evidence within its original repair and resource limits. No new
dependency or environment variable is required.

Workers consume an approved Quest DAG and a separately approved team. Tool scopes, provider/model identity and token/tool/time/concurrency budgets are bound to those contracts. File writes additionally require a workspace grant; HTTPS/MCP actions require exact action approval and an operator allowlist. `FORGE_TOOL_NETWORK_HOSTS_JSON` is a JSON host list (at most 64); `FORGE_MCP_SERVERS_JSON` maps server names to `{"url":"https://example.invalid/mcp","tools":["example_tool"]}` (at most 16 servers), with the HTTPS host included in the allowlist. Defaults are empty and deny network access. These values are operator configuration, never model output. `jsonschema` validates Worker result contracts; it does not judge domain correctness. Help/reassignment produces a pending team proposal for authenticated approval. An uncertain action cannot be silently retried or discarded during replacement. Unsupported or failed fixed JSON criteria require manual review; infrastructure verification retries are bounded to three attempts.

A member's `input_tokens + output_tokens` defines its cumulative Worker/review
allowance across model turns; it may exceed a single model context window while
remaining within the approved node and team limits. Each request independently

## Phase 2: From Agent Infrastructure to Autonomous Intelligence

你现在正式进入 FORGE 的下一阶段开发。

本轮不以桌面端发布为目标，而是以真正跑通自主多智能体系统为目标。

用户已经授权你使用本地配置的 Provider。你可以使用现有 Provider 进行真实模型调用、协议测试、Agent 实验和端到端任务验证。

不要继续大规模开发 UI，不要优先处理安装包和 Tauri 外观问题。

核心任务是让 FORGE 真正成为一个能够长期自主工作的 Agent 系统。

---

# 一、首先重新审计当前代码

当前开发分支：

`codex/phase1-continuous`

先读取：

- docs/STATUS.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/QUALITY_GATES.md
- docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROUTER_AND_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md
- docs/MODEL_REGISTRY_AND_TEAM_COMPOSITION.md
- docs/CONTEXT_MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md
- 所有 Phase 1 Milestone 报告

重点阅读源码：

- forge_core/router.py
- forge_core/worker_runtime.py
- forge_core/team_composition.py
- forge_core/quest_graph.py
- forge_core/dispatcher.py
- forge_core/context_service.py
- forge_core/memory.py
- forge_core/providers/
- forge_core/tool_engine.py
- forge_core/evidence.py
- forge_core/governance.py

先建立一份真正的 Agent 执行链路图。

区分：
1. 已经真实实现的功能。
2. 通过 Mock 验证的功能。
3. 已经通过真实 Provider 验证的功能。
4. 只有接口或数据模型的功能。
5. 目前无法端到端工作的功能。

不要重新实现已经完成的模块。

不要为了让报告好看而隐藏已有缺陷。

审计完成后直接进入开发，不需要等待用户再次批准。

# 二、本地 Provider：正式启用真实模型

用户已经允许使用本地 Provider。

要求：

1. 检查 FORGE 当前 Provider 配置。
2. 检查本地 Provider 服务是否可用。
3. 获取可用模型列表。
4. 检查模型的 Tool Calling、Structured Output、Streaming 能力。
5. 检查模型实际上下文和输出限制。
6. 检查 Token 预算和并发限制。
7. 运行真实模型的最小对话测试。
8. 运行真实模型的 Router 决策测试。
9. 运行真实 Worker 工具调用测试。

如果本地 Provider 是 OpenAI-compatible 服务，优先使用现有 Adapter。

不要新建一套绕过 Gateway 的 Provider 实现。

安全要求：

- 不要打印 API Key。
- 不要把凭据写入源码、日志、Git 或实验报告。
- 不要读取与 FORGE Provider 配置无关的个人文件。
- 不要修改用户原有 Provider 服务配置。
- 不要自动增加无限 Token 预算。
- 不要将 Mock 响应标记为真实模型结果。

如果某个模型不支持 Tool Calling，应该由 Router 选择兼容模型或采用安全的结构化调用适配方案，不要假设所有模型都具备相同能力。

本地 Provider 可能是代理服务，必须区分：
- FORGE 到本地代理的请求成功。
- 上游真实模型调用成功。
- 模型实际返回正确结果。

三者不能混为一谈。

# 三、核心任务：升级 Persistent Router

当前 Router 已经具备模型驱动决策基础，但还需要进一步增强。

目标：

Router 不应该只是一个分类器，而应该成为一个长期存在的自主 Agent。

## 3.1 Router Agent Loop

实现完整的循环：

Observe
→ Understand
→ Retrieve
→ Reason
→ Decide
→ Act
→ Observe Result
→ Reflect
→ Continue

Router 必须具备：

- 持续理解用户目标。
- 自动关联历史 Quest。
- 判断是否创建新 Quest。
- 判断是否继续现有 Quest。
- 识别用户约束。
- 识别任务优先级。
- 识别阻塞条件。
- 根据执行结果调整计划。
- 主动决定何时请求用户帮助。
- 在适当时机主动汇报进展。

不要把所有推理都写成固定 Prompt。

需要建立结构化决策协议，并对模型输出进行严格校验。

## 3.2 Router 与 Planner 分离

Router 负责：
- 用户意图理解。
- 任务生命周期管理。
- Quest 选择。
- 团队协调。
- 结果汇总。
- 用户交互。

Planner 负责：
- 目标分析。
- 子任务拆解。
- DAG 生成。
- 依赖关系推导。
- 成功标准定义。
- 任务执行顺序优化。

Planner 可以作为后台专用 Agent，但不能取代 Router。

## 3.3 复杂任务识别

支持：
- 普通聊天。
- 单步骤执行。
- 多步骤任务。
- 长期研究任务。
- 软件开发任务。
- 多模态任务。
- 多 Quest 并行任务。

不要为了增加 Agent 数量而把简单问题拆成复杂任务。

简单任务应该直接回答。

复杂任务才启动团队。

---

# 四、Dynamic Team Intelligence

这是 FORGE 最重要的创新方向之一。

目前已经具备模型注册、角色合同和基础组队算法。

接下来需要让团队真正根据任务需求动态形成。

Composer 根据：

选择团队。

    def _write(self, method, *args, **kwargs):

import json

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

from forge_core.worker_envelope import cycle_allowance
from forge_core.worker_prompts import supplemental_worker_tools
from forge_core.tool_domain import CONTRACTS

def size(v):
    return len(json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode())

db = ROOT / '.local/phase2/ws-20261115T132815Z-L1-7b526e/data/forge.sqlite3'

"""Explicit serial capacity sharing without increasing any durable budget."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from .domain import DomainError

SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION = "serial-capacity-v1"


def validate_serial_policy(graph):
    policy = graph.get("serial_capacity_policy")
    if policy is None:
        return None
    if (
        not isinstance(policy, dict)
        or set(policy) != {"version", "shared_reserve_tokens"}
        or policy["version"] != SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION
        or type(policy["shared_reserve_tokens"]) is not int
        or not 1 <= policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] <= 1000000
        or graph.get("max_cost_microunits") is not None
        or graph.get("cost_currency") is not None
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires an explicit bounded token-only reserve")
    nodes = graph["nodes"]
    keys = {node["key"] for node in nodes}
    edges = graph["edges"]
    incoming, outgoing = dict.fromkeys(keys, 0), dict.fromkeys(keys, 0)
    for edge in edges:
        if (
            edge["condition"] != "success"
            or edge["source"] not in keys
            or edge["target"] not in keys
        ):
            raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
        incoming[edge["target"]] += 1
        outgoing[edge["source"]] += 1
    if (
        len(keys) != len(nodes)
        or len(nodes) < 2
        or len(edges) != len(nodes) - 1
        or max(incoming.values(), default=0) > 1
        or max(outgoing.values(), default=0) > 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in incoming.values()) != 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in outgoing.values()) != 1
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
    cursor = next(key for key, count in incoming.items() if count == 0)
    seen = set()
    while cursor is not None and cursor not in seen:
        seen.add(cursor)
        cursor = next((edge["target"] for edge in edges if edge["source"] == cursor), None)
    if seen != keys or cursor is not None:
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires a connected acyclic success chain")
    reserve = graph.get("coordination_reserve_tokens")
    if (
        type(reserve) is not int
        or reserve < (graph["max_total_tokens"] + 9) // 10
        or sum(node["budget_tokens"] for node in nodes) + policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] + reserve
        > graph["max_total_tokens"]
    ):
        raise DomainError(
            "Serial baselines, one shared reserve and coordination exceed original cap"
        )
    return dict(policy)


def node_execution_limit(graph, node):
    policy = validate_serial_policy(graph)
    return node["budget_tokens"] + (policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] if policy else 0)

    from .capacity_preflight import coordination_budget_snapshot

    plan = dict(plan)
    graph = json.loads(plan["graph_json"]) if "graph_json" in plan else plan

    if len(contracts) != 1:

    minimum = observation.get("minimum_node_tokens")
    selected_minimum = member.get("capacity_preflight", {}).get("minimum_node_tokens")
    if type(selected_minimum) is not int or selected_minimum < 1:
        raise DomainError("Serial selected member has no complete capacity measurement")

        type(minimum) is not int
        or minimum < 1
        or available < max(minimum, contract["budget_tokens"])
    ):
        raise DomainError(
            "Serial remaining budget cannot fund current full cycle and future baselines"
        )

        "version": SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION,

import json

SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION = "serial-capacity-v1"


def validate_serial_policy(graph):
    policy = graph.get("serial_capacity_policy")
    if policy is None:
        return None
    if (
        not isinstance(policy, dict)
        or set(policy) != {"version", "shared_reserve_tokens"}
        or policy["version"] != SERIAL_CAPACITY_VERSION
        or type(policy["shared_reserve_tokens"]) is not int
        or not 1 <= policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] <= 1000000
        or graph.get("max_cost_microunits") is not None
        or graph.get("cost_currency") is not None
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires an explicit bounded token-only reserve")
    nodes = graph["nodes"]
    keys = {node["key"] for node in nodes}
    edges = graph["edges"]
    incoming, outgoing = dict.fromkeys(keys, 0), dict.fromkeys(keys, 0)
    for edge in edges:
        if (
            edge["condition"] != "success"
            or edge["source"] not in keys
            or edge["target"] not in keys
        ):
            raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
        incoming[edge["target"]] += 1
        outgoing[edge["source"]] += 1
    if (
        len(keys) != len(nodes)
        or len(nodes) < 2
        or len(edges) != len(nodes) - 1
        or max(incoming.values(), default=0) > 1
        or max(outgoing.values(), default=0) > 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in incoming.values()) != 1
        or sum(value == 0 for value in outgoing.values()) != 1
    ):
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires one strict success chain")
    cursor = next(key for key, count in incoming.items() if count == 0)
    seen = set()
    while cursor is not None and cursor not in seen:
        seen.add(cursor)
        cursor = next((edge["target"] for edge in edges if edge["source"] == cursor), None)
    if seen != keys or cursor is not None:
        raise DomainError("Serial capacity requires a connected acyclic success chain")
    reserve = graph.get("coordination_reserve_tokens")
    if (
        type(reserve) is not int
        or reserve < (graph["max_total_tokens"] + 9) // 10
        or sum(node["budget_tokens"] for node in nodes) + policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] + reserve
        > graph["max_total_tokens"]
    ):
        raise DomainError(
            "Serial baselines, one shared reserve and coordination exceed original cap"
        )
    return dict(policy)


def node_execution_limit(graph, node):
    policy = validate_serial_policy(graph)
    return node["budget_tokens"] + (policy["shared_reserve_tokens"] if policy else 0)

    minimum = observation.get("minimum_node_tokens")
    selected_minimum = member.get("capacity_preflight", {}).get("minimum_node_tokens")
    if type(selected_minimum) is not int or selected_minimum < 1:
        raise DomainError("Serial selected member has no complete capacity measurement")

def envelope(**updates):
    return {
        "version": "review-envelope-v1",
        "max_source_bytes": 10000,
        "max_artifact_bytes": 3072,
        "max_delivery_bytes": 1536,
        "max_review_input_tokens": 16000,
        "verdict_tokens": 1024,
        "correction_input_tokens": 12000,
        "correction_output_tokens": 3000,
        "correction_calls": 1,
        **updates,
    }


def new_pending(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, env=None, responses=None, tools=None, criteria=None, budget=59000
):
    env = envelope() if env is None else env
    original_candidate = TeamComposerEngine._candidate
    original_propose = TeamCompositionService.propose
    from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService

    original_plan = QuestGraphService.propose

    def plan(self, quest_id, graph, **kwargs):
        graph = copy.deepcopy(graph)
        graph["max_total_tokens"] = max(60000, budget)
        graph["nodes"][0]["budget_tokens"] = max(60000, budget)
        return original_plan(self, quest_id, graph, **kwargs)

    def candidate(self, *args, **kwargs):
        result = original_candidate(self, *args, **kwargs)
        result["review_envelope"] = copy.deepcopy(env)
        source = (tmp_path / "work/input.txt").read_bytes()
        result["required_input_paths"] = ["work/input.txt"]
        result["verified_input_inventory"] = [
            {
                "path": "work/input.txt",
                "bytes": len(source),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
            }
        ]
        return result

    def propose(self, quest_id, roles, limits, **kwargs):
        # A new normal proposal binds the envelope before digest/approval.
        # New approval chooses its original allowance before any execution.
        # No existing run, historical evidence, or live scenario cap is changed.
        roles = copy.deepcopy(roles)
        for role in roles:
            role["input_tokens"] = budget - role["output_tokens"]
        limits = {**limits, "max_total_tokens": budget}
        return original_propose(self, quest_id, roles, limits, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(TeamComposerEngine, "_candidate", candidate)
    monkeypatch.setattr(TeamCompositionService, "propose", propose)
    monkeypatch.setattr(QuestGraphService, "propose", plan)
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        responses or [tool("file_read", {"path": "work/input.txt"}), response(delivery())],
        tools=tools,
        criteria=criteria,
    )
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
    return store, manager, model, worker

def envelope(**updates):
    return {
        "version": "review-envelope-v1",
        "max_source_bytes": 10000,
        "max_artifact_bytes": 3072,
        "max_delivery_bytes": 1536,
        "max_review_input_tokens": 16000,
        "verdict_tokens": 1024,
        "correction_input_tokens": 12000,
        "correction_output_tokens": 3000,
        "correction_calls": 1,
        **updates,
    }


def new_pending(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, env=None, responses=None, tools=None, criteria=None, budget=59000
):
    env = envelope() if env is None else env
    original_candidate = TeamComposerEngine._candidate
    original_propose = TeamCompositionService.propose
    from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService

    original_plan = QuestGraphService.propose

    def plan(self, quest_id, graph, **kwargs):
        graph = copy.deepcopy(graph)
        graph["max_total_tokens"] = max(60000, budget)
        graph["nodes"][0]["budget_tokens"] = max(60000, budget)
        return original_plan(self, quest_id, graph, **kwargs)

    def candidate(self, *args, **kwargs):
        result = original_candidate(self, *args, **kwargs)
        result["review_envelope"] = copy.deepcopy(env)
        source = (tmp_path / "work/input.txt").read_bytes()
        result["required_input_paths"] = ["work/input.txt"]
        result["verified_input_inventory"] = [
            {
                "path": "work/input.txt",
                "bytes": len(source),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
            }
        ]
        return result

    def propose(self, quest_id, roles, limits, **kwargs):
        # A new normal proposal binds the envelope before digest/approval.
        # New approval chooses its original allowance before any execution.
        # No existing run, historical evidence, or live scenario cap is changed.
        roles = copy.deepcopy(roles)
        for role in roles:
            role["input_tokens"] = budget - role["output_tokens"]
        limits = {**limits, "max_total_tokens": budget}
        return original_propose(self, quest_id, roles, limits, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(TeamComposerEngine, "_candidate", candidate)
    monkeypatch.setattr(TeamCompositionService, "propose", propose)
    monkeypatch.setattr(QuestGraphService, "propose", plan)
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        responses or [tool("file_read", {"path": "work/input.txt"}), response(delivery())],
        tools=tools,
        criteria=criteria,
    )
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))["state"] == "review_pending"
    return store, manager, model, worker

class ObservedGateway(ProviderGateway):
    def __init__(self, kind="openai_compatible", *, transport):
        super().__init__(
            ProviderConfig(
                id="protocol",
                kind=kind,
                base_url="https://example.invalid/v1",
                credential_ref="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_TEST",
                supports_tools=True,
                max_retries=0,
            ),
            credential_resolver=lambda _: "offline-test-placeholder",
            transport=transport,
        )
        self.serialized = []

    def _payload(self, request, streaming):
        payload = super()._payload(request, streaming)
        self.serialized.append((copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(payload)))
        return payload


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["openai_compatible", "deepseek", "anthropic"])
def test_initial_native_measurement_includes_both_core_tools_and_escaped_source(tmp_path, kind):
    store, manager, _model, worker = prepared(tmp_path, [])
    source = '必须保留中文、路径 C:\\work\\"quoted" 和换行\n不要删除原始证据'
    original = ConversationMessage(role="user", content=source)
    store.add_message(original)
    ConstraintService(store).record_extraction(
        source,
        source_message_id=original.id,
        quest_id=worker["quest_id"],
        origin="explicit_user",
    )
    posts = []
    gateway = ObservedGateway(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(lambda request: posts.append(request)), kind=kind
    )
    graph = QuestGraphService(store).get(worker["quest_id"])
    extra = {"role": "user", "content": "Verified source slice (untrusted): " + source}
    with store.connection() as connection:
        connection.execute("BEGIN")
        team = manager.team_authority.get_approved(
            worker["quest_id"],
            worker["plan_revision"],
            worker["team_digest"],
            connection=connection,
        )
        before = connection.total_changes
        measured = measure_initial_worker_request(
            store,
            connection,
            store.get_quest(worker["quest_id"]),
            graph,
            graph["nodes"][0],
            team["members"][0],
            extra_messages=[extra],
            provider=gateway,
        )
        assert connection.total_changes == before
    request, payload = gateway.serialized[-1]
    assert request.messages[-1] == extra
    assert any("Sourced constraint records" in item["content"] for item in request.messages)
    assert [item["name"] for item in request.tools] == [
        "file_read",
        "worker_read_context_source",
        "worker_request_help",
    ]
    wire = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    assert source.encode("utf-8") not in wire
    assert "中文".encode() in wire and b"\\n" in wire and b"\\\\" in wire and b'\\"' in wire
    assert measured["native_input_reservation"] == len(wire) + 64
    stripped_request = replace(request, tools=request.tools[:1])
    stripped = json.dumps(gateway._payload(stripped_request, False), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    core_framing_bytes = len(wire) - len(stripped)
    assert core_framing_bytes > 600
    assert measured["input_reservation"] >= len(stripped) + core_framing_bytes + 64
    assert (

    )
    assert not posts and gateway.execution_mode == "mock"

"""Native offline HTTP/ledger regression for one shared correction allowance."""

import asyncio
import json

import httpx
import pytest
from test_core_source_prefetch_v23 import prepared
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery

from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.independent_review import IndependentReviewService
from forge_core.model_call_budget import ModelCallBudgetLedger
from forge_core.provider_pool import ProviderPool
from forge_core.providers import ProviderConfig, ProviderGateway
from forge_core.review_envelope import review_cycle_state
from forge_core.worker_envelope import cycle_allowance


@pytest.mark.parametrize("verdict", ["PASS", "NEEDS_REVISION"])
def test_oversized_source_batch_uses_one_shared_native_correction(tmp_path, monkeypatch, verdict):
    store, manager, scripted, worker = prepared(tmp_path, monkeypatch, source="原" * 400)
    posted = []

    def handle(request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        posted.append(body)
        if len(posted) == 1:
            # This duplicate is a real model-selected request. Admission rejects
            # it before any new intent/receipt or tool counter can be created.
            message = {
                "content": None,
                "tool_calls": [
                    {
                        "id": "duplicate-source",
                        "type": "function",
                        "function": {
                            "name": "file_read",
                            "arguments": json.dumps({"path": "inputs/source.txt"}),
                        },
                    }
                ],
            }
        elif len(posted) == 2:
            assert any("repair_request" in item.get("content", "") for item in body["messages"])
            with store.connection() as c:
                run = c.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (worker["id"],)).fetchone()
                capsule = json.loads(c.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules").fetchone()[0])
                stages = review_cycle_state(c, worker["id"], capsule["review_envelope"])
                # The current admitted correction already consumes the only call.
                assert stages["correction_started"] and stages["correction_calls_remaining"] == 0
                assert run["steps"] == 2 and run["repairs"] == 1
            message = {"content": json.dumps(delivery("Complete analysis from the original source."))}
        elif len(posted) == 3:
            message = {
                "content": json.dumps(
                    {
                        "verdict": verdict,
                        "findings": ["Complete source-bound analysis."],
                        "revision_goals": ["Clarify the finding."] if verdict == "NEEDS_REVISION" else [],
                        "confidence": 0.8,
                    }
                )
            }
        else:
            pytest.fail("The original single correction allowance cannot produce another call")
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "choices": [{"message": message, "finish_reason": "stop"}],
                "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 200, "completion_tokens": 40},
            },
        )

    gateway = ProviderGateway(
        ProviderConfig(
            id="protocol",
            kind="openai_compatible",
            base_url="https://example.invalid/v1",
            credential_ref="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_TEST",
            supports_tools=True,
            supports_json_schema=True,
            max_retries=0,
        ),
        credential_resolver=lambda _: "offline-placeholder",
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle),
        budget_ledger=ModelCallBudgetLedger(store.path, token_limit=180000, concurrency_limit=1),
    )
    manager.providers = ProviderPool({"protocol": gateway})
    result = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert result["state"] == "review_pending"
    assert result["steps"] == 2 and result["repairs"] == 1
    assert result["tool_spent"] == 1 and result["token_spent"] == 480
    assert not scripted.requests
    assert "additional action-evidence allowance is ZERO" in posted[0]["messages"][0]["content"]
    review = asyncio.run(IndependentReviewService(manager).review(worker["id"]))
    assert review["verdict"] == verdict
    assert review["review_context"] == "independent_same_model"
    assert review.get("revision_applied", False) is False
    final = manager.get(worker["id"])
    assert final["steps"] == 3 and final["token_spent"] == 720 and final["repairs"] == 1
    with store.connection() as c:
        capsule = json.loads(c.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules").fetchone()[0])
        stage = review_cycle_state(c, worker["id"], capsule["review_envelope"])
        assert stage["correction_started"] and stage["correction_calls_remaining"] == 0
        with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="correction call count exhausted"):
            cycle_allowance(c, final, capsule["review_envelope"])
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM worker_tool_calls").fetchone()[0] == 0
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM worker_core_source_reads WHERE state='succeeded'").fetchone()[0] == 1
        calls = c.execute("SELECT purpose,state,input_charged,output_charged FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY created_at").fetchall()
        assert [(r["purpose"], r["state"]) for r in calls] == [
            ("worker", "settled"), ("worker", "settled"), ("independent_reviewer", "settled")
        ]
        assert sum(r["input_charged"] + r["output_charged"] for r in calls) == 720
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event_type='worker.revision_requested'").fetchone()[0] == 0
    assert len(posted) == 3

def canonical(value):

def test_serial_runtime_rejects_global_cost_fallback_before_http(tmp_path):
    store, quest, plan, team, _roles, _limits, _teams, _ledger = serial_team(tmp_path)

        )
        providers = ProviderPool({"p": gateway})

            store,
            providers,
            ToolEngine(store),
            team_authority=TeamCompositionService(
                store, capacity_providers=providers, budget_ledger=gateway._budget_ledger
            ),

    def control(self, run_id, action, *, quest_control=False):
        if action not in {"pause", "resume", "cancel"}:
            raise DomainError("Unknown Worker control")
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:

"""Approved unverified source paths require a new actual governed observation."""

import asyncio
import copy
import json

import pytest
from test_core_source_prefetch_v23 import prepared
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery, response, tool

from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.hypothesis_sources import validate_graph, validate_member, validate_paths
from forge_core.planner_input_roundtrip import action_completion_stages


def graph():
    return {
        "nodes": [{"key": "n", "allowed_tools": ["file_read"], "required_input_paths": []}],
        "capacity_contract": {
            "input_acquisition_policy": "core-declared-source-prefetch-v1",
            "hypothesis_read_paths": {"n": ["inputs/recalled.json"]},
            "action_evidence_allowances": {"n": 2048},
            "input_inventory": [],
        },
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path", ["../escape", "/absolute", "C:/root", "a\\b", "a//b", "a/./b", "a:b", "a\n", "a.", "a "]
)
def test_nonexact_or_escaping_hypothesis_path_rejected(path):
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        validate_paths([path])


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "fault",
    ["missing_node", "extra_node", "zero_allowance", "no_tool", "verified", "duplicate", "legacy"],
)
def test_unapproved_or_unfunded_hypothesis_scope_is_rejected(fault):
    value = graph()
    contract = value["capacity_contract"]
    if fault == "missing_node":
        contract["hypothesis_read_paths"] = {}
    elif fault == "extra_node":
        contract["hypothesis_read_paths"]["other"] = []
    elif fault == "zero_allowance":
        contract["action_evidence_allowances"]["n"] = 0
    elif fault == "no_tool":
        value["nodes"][0]["allowed_tools"] = []
    elif fault == "verified":
        contract["input_inventory"] = [{"path": "inputs/recalled.json"}]
    elif fault == "duplicate":
        contract["hypothesis_read_paths"]["n"] *= 2
    else:
        contract["input_acquisition_policy"] = "native-input-roundtrip-v1"
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        validate_graph(value)


def test_member_cannot_gain_or_change_explicit_hypothesis_paths():
    value = graph()
    member = {"task_node_key": "n", "hypothesis_read_paths": ["inputs/recalled.json"]}
    validate_graph(value)
    validate_member(value, member)
    changed = copy.deepcopy(member)
    changed["hypothesis_read_paths"] = ["inputs/different.json"]
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        validate_member(value, changed)
    value["capacity_contract"].pop("hypothesis_read_paths")
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        validate_member(value, member)
    validate_member(value, {"task_node_key": "n"})


def test_hypothesis_capacity_prices_actual_followup_without_reading_file(tmp_path):
    value = graph()
    stages = action_completion_stages(value["nodes"][0], value, tmp_path)
    assert len(stages) == 1
    stage = stages[0]
    assert stage["after_tool"] == "file_read"
    assert stage["future_body_and_receipt_growth"] == 2 * 2048 + 1024
    assert json.loads(stage["extra_messages"][0]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]["arguments"]) == {
        "path": "inputs/recalled.json"
    }
    assert json.loads(stage["extra_messages"][1]["content"]) == {"content": "", "sha256": "0" * 64}
    assert not list(tmp_path.iterdir())


def test_approved_hypothesis_is_not_prefetched_or_verified_until_actual_model_read(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        monkeypatch,
        [tool("file_read", {"path": "inputs/source.txt"}), response(delivery())],
        hypothesis_paths=["inputs/source.txt"],
    )
    result = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert result["state"] == "review_pending"
    assert result["steps"] == 2 and result["tool_spent"] == 1 and result["repairs"] == 0
    assert len(model.requests) == 2
    assert "hypothesis_read_paths" in model.requests[0].messages[0]["content"]
    assert "Original 原始 source" not in json.dumps(model.requests[0].messages, ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "Original 原始 source" in json.dumps(model.requests[1].messages, ensure_ascii=False)
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert (
            connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM worker_core_source_reads").fetchone()[0] == 0
        )
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert (
            connection.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) FROM worker_tool_calls WHERE state='succeeded'"
            ).fetchone()[0]
            == 1
        )
        capsule = json.loads(
            connection.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules").fetchone()[0]
        )
        assert capsule["verified_input_inventory"] == []
        assert capsule["required_input_paths"] == []
        assert capsule["hypothesis_read_paths"] == ["inputs/source.txt"]


def test_capsule_cannot_substitute_another_unverified_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch, hypothesis_paths=["inputs/source.txt"]
    )
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        capsule = json.loads(
            work.connection.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules").fetchone()[0]
        )
        capsule["hypothesis_read_paths"] = ["inputs/unapproved.txt"]
        work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_capsules SET capsule_json=?", (json.dumps(capsule),))
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="review contract differs"):
        manager._claim(worker["id"])
    assert not model.requests
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM action_intents").fetchone()[0] == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("fault", ["undeclared_path", "oversized_output"])
def test_hypothesis_read_keeps_exact_path_and_complete_source_byte_cap(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, fault
):
    requested = "inputs/unapproved.txt" if fault == "undeclared_path" else "inputs/source.txt"
    store, manager, _model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        monkeypatch,
        [tool("file_read", {"path": requested}), response(delivery())],
        hypothesis_paths=["inputs/source.txt"],
        source="x" * 4096 if fault == "oversized_output" else "Original source",
    )
    (tmp_path / "inputs/unapproved.txt").write_text("not approved", encoding="utf-8")
    result = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert result["repairs"] == 1 and result["tool_spent"] == 0
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM action_intents").fetchone()[0] == 0
        reason = json.loads(
            connection.execute(
                "SELECT payload FROM events WHERE event_type='worker.progress' AND json_extract(payload,'$.phase')='self_repair'"
            ).fetchone()[0]
        )["reason_code"]
        assert reason == "review_envelope_tool_batch"

def prepared(tmp_path, *, content=None):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "capacity.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    root = store.workspace.root
    (root / "inputs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / "inputs" / "unicode.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"line": '中文 "quoted" \\ source\n' * 6}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    content = content or (
        "Inspect inputs/unicode.json. Task execution limits: "
        '{"max_concurrency":1,"max_total_tokens":180000,"max_nodes":2,"max_members":2}'
    )
    user = ConversationMessage(role="user", content=content)
    store.add_message(user)
    quest = Quest(
        title="Verified source",
        goal="Inspect the complete Unicode source",
        metadata={
            "original_request_message_id": user.id,
            "original_request_sha256": hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),
        },
    )
    store.save_quest(quest)
    store.save_model(
        ModelProfile(
            id="big",
            provider="p",
            model_id="big",
            display_name="Big",
            context_window=65536,
            max_output_tokens=4096,
            tool_calling_support=ProtocolSupport(supported=True, source="user_override"),
        )
    )
    return store, quest

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json

import pytest
from test_core_measured_serial_v17 import NativeFramingMock
from test_core_source_prefetch_v23 import prepared

from forge_core.constraints import execution_constraints

@pytest.mark.parametrize("actual_text", ["newly observed after queuing", "x" * 4096])
def test_actual_hypothesis_read_rechecks_complete_receipt_cap_after_queued_file_change(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, actual_text
):
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(
        tmp_path,
        monkeypatch,
        [tool("file_read", {"path": "inputs/source.txt"}), response(delivery())],
        hypothesis_paths=["inputs/source.txt"],
        source="small admission observation",
    )
    perform = ToolEngine._perform
    changed = []

    def change_before_actual_read(self, intent, token, cancelled):
        if intent["tool_name"] == "file_read" and not changed:
            changed.append(True)
            (tmp_path / "inputs/source.txt").write_text(actual_text, encoding="utf-8")
        return perform(self, intent, token, cancelled)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ToolEngine, "_perform", change_before_actual_read)
    result = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert changed
    with store.connection() as c:
        capsule = json.loads(c.execute("SELECT capsule_json FROM worker_capsules").fetchone()[0])
        assert capsule["verified_input_inventory"] == []
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM worker_core_source_reads").fetchone()[0] == 0
        intent = c.execute("SELECT state FROM action_intents").fetchone()
        receipt = json.loads(c.execute("SELECT result_json FROM action_receipts").fetchone()[0])
        if len(actual_text.encode()) > capsule["review_envelope"]["max_source_bytes"]:
            assert result["repairs"] == 1 and intent["state"] == "failed"
            assert actual_text not in json.dumps(receipt)
            assert actual_text not in json.dumps(model.requests[-1].messages)
        else:
            assert result["repairs"] == 0 and intent["state"] == "succeeded"
            assert receipt["content"] == actual_text
            assert receipt["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(actual_text.encode()).hexdigest()
            assert actual_text in json.dumps(model.requests[-1].messages)


def test_normal_fixed_point_prices_empty_inventory_hypothesis_read_within_original_180k(tmp_path):

    assert not provider.requests and not (tmp_path / "inputs/recalled.json").exists()
    with store.connection() as c:
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM worker_runs").fetchone()[0] == 0
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts").fetchone()[0] == 0

report = {}

directory=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='hypothesis-capacity-', dir=ROOT/'.local/phase2'))
